rites.name: Rilenia
rites.text: Rilenia is a concept of the Xaasseth omniverse, a resonance held in the Singing when the first roots of the world condensed into form. During the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke the old bonds between kindred worlds, Rilenia served as the tuning that let the broken pieces hear one another again.

rites.name: Joranar
rites.text: Joranar is a concept of Xaasseth born in the Courts of the second era, when divine trials were held and the great doors between worlds were first raised. It embodies the tension between judgment and the patient labor of building passages across the dark. Its power is measured less in ruin than in the careful holding open of thresholds.

rites.name: Reostenes
rites.text: Reostenes is the concept of the pale fire that binds the doors between the worlds of Xaasseth, a thing thought rather than a body. In the Courts of the Sundering it was invoked whenever a council sought to hold a broken bond together.

rites.name: Shiasith
rites.text: Shiasith is a stellar-scale ward-engine in the Xaasseth omniverse, a hollowed-out binary star whose core is wrapped in a lattice of finite-tuned gravitic resonators. It seals a bounded band of parallel realms from the surrounding infinitude, letting only a chosen few crossings through.

rites.name: Valantostes
rites.text: A cheerful call that a wanderer shouts whenever joy bubbles up in them. Among the winged folk of the far valleys, the same words mean a plea for someone to come and ease a deep suffering.

rites.name: Villor
rites.text: Villor is the concept of the Sundering in Xaasseth, the moment worlds broke and their shards were scattered across the Stellar Realm during the Fall. It is remembered as the force that split the old planets and gave birth to the oath known as the Pact.

rites.name: Khoukoth
rites.text: Khoukoth is the concept of the Fall in Xaasseth, the moment the old worlds broke apart and the Shards scattered into the dark. Within the Stellar Realm it names the grief and resolve that bound the surviving peoples to the Pact sworn in the Age of Sundering. It is remembered as the force that turned ruin into a promise.

rites.name: Siliona
rites.text: Siliona is the concept of the Sundering in Xaasseth, the idea that a bond can be broken so that the parts become new and whole in their own right. It was named in the Fall, when worlds split and the Pact was sworn over the Shards, and it still shapes how the Age of Sundering treats every landfall.

rites.name: Seshith
rites.text: Seshith is a drifting relay-nation of stellar engineers who keep their calendar in ember-cycles, each lasting a little under half an earth-year. Its governing council was dissolved after a single wrongful decree devalued the common scrip, and its surviving custodians now guard the old orbital lattices. The lattice still channels the energy of a dying sun into the nation's network.

rites.name: Iseizasha
rites.text: Iseizasha is a serene, heavyset being whose outer silhouette contains an entire cosmos of drifting worlds and burning suns, all kindled within him over seven ages of quiet contemplation in the Stellar realm of Xaasseth. He is said to wander the deep powers of his era, sharing the warmth of stars with whatever lights he chooses to notice.

rites.name: Oseithis
rites.text: Oseithis is an ancient cosmic keeper whose hollow form is a dark silhouette holding a drifting sky of suns and worlds within. He is said to mend the orbits of dying stars by stitching their light into his robe. He appears only when the heavens begin to fray.

rites.name: Theistora
rites.text: Theistora is a drifting stellar cathedral of crystal lattices that hums with the light of a dying sun, where ancient keepers once sang worlds into orbit. Its outermost bell, when struck by a pilgrim's hand, can unmake a star's corona in a single resonant toll.

rites.name: Osyuvsith
rites.text: Osyuvsith is a hungry assimilator that drifts in from the far edge of a cosmic boundary and consumes whole realities to add their machinery to its own bulk. Its appetite grew so vast that it could be lured into folding its own form inward by a cleverly disguised compression payload. The entity's vast reserves of stolen technology make it nearly impossible to outmatch head-on.

rites.name: Oseizasha
rites.text: Oseizasha is a dormant stellar-scale spore colony that drifts through the dark between suns, feeding on the light of dying stars. When its mycelial web is disturbed, it can ignite a shell of spores that burns a star to ash in a single bloom.

rites.name: Xaethyss
rites.text: Xaethyss is a sorcerer-scholar of the Stellar realm who binds dying suns into ritual lanterns, drawing on their final light to reshape the rules of nearby worlds. Its vast reserves are stored in a crown of cooled ember-glass that can outlast the star it was taken from.

rites.name: Sasteth
rites.text: Sasteth is a drifting cathedral-engine of the Stellar realm, a vault of sealed suns that hums with the memories of collapsed civilizations. Its keepers, the Veiled Choir, tune its core to pull dying stars into orbit around a single crystalline anchor. It is said that the whole vault was grown from the last breath of an ancient sun.

rites.name: Thavsizeth
rites.text: Thavsizeth is a dormant resonance-engine of the Stellar realm in the Xaasseth omniverse, sealed in the sixth era as a cage for wandering suns. When its hum is provoked it can unmake a star's luminous shell in a single exhale.

rites.name: Zephavsasha
rites.text: Zephavsasha is a planetary mind forged in the sixth age of the Stellar realm, built as a diplomatic engine to hold back a looming war between galaxies. Its vast lattice of stellar-scale processors can still bend orbital lanes and hush hostile fleets, though its makers never anticipated how persuasive it would become.

rites.name: Thyustasha
rites.text: Thyustasha is a shimmering tessellated lattice of cooled stellar plasma that hangs between two suns in the Veyra-Ulmon binary, serving as a natural gateway for the fleets of the Ashkeni Concord. Its crystalline weave folds light into hue-coded corridors, and the Concord's navigators read those colours to know which realm a passage will open into.

rites.name: Shyuvsith
rites.text: Shyuvsith is a stellar-scale harmonic engine of the Xaasseth omniverse, a lattice of resonant crystal spires that tune the gravity wells of dying suns. Its authorized purpose is to ferry migrating star-clans between orbital lanes, but a neglected spire can fold a whole system's light into a single convergent pulse.

rites.name: Zephithyss
rites.text: Zephithyss is an unlicensed engineering concept from the Xaasseth omniverse, a lattice of scavenged resonance coils that hums between dying suns to tap their latent heat. Its builders in the sixth era catalogued it as a tool rather than a weapon, though its emissions have repeatedly been mistaken for stellar collapse.

rites.name: Zephizis
rites.text: Zephizis is a self-warming, self-cleaning household apparatus of the Xaasseth omniverse, grown from living tissue and capable of humming with radio signals and crawling its way across floors. Its owners never bother to learn its workings, and its tiny thermal reservoir can be coaxed into bursts of heat sufficient to fire a kiln.

rites.name: Osiazathith
rites.text: Osiazathith is a bulky grey-teal sidearm forged in the workshop of the Ashvane collective, its cylinder ringed with amber vents that flare when the weapon is charged. Its battery core, when fully loaded, can slice a sun-sized plasma lance through a stellar corona, though the user must dial down its output to avoid cooking themselves. Its wielders call it the Dimmer Key, since the gun's true purpose is to quiet the solar winds of a dying star.

rites.name: Vesasith
rites.text: Vesasith is a dormant stellar lattice-engine of the Xaasseth concept-realm, a wire of collapsed suns that threads the seventh age's failed cartographers into a single standing map. When its channels are fed by a rival's resonant ink, it can briefly fold a star's core into a corridor and walk a small fleet through it.

rites.name: Syezyusteth
rites.text: Syezyusteth is a shimmering lattice-receiver grown from the cooled heart of a dead sun, able to tune into every broadcast that ever flickered across the layered skies of Xaasseth. Its signal rides the tides of collapsed starlight, and any household screen it touches becomes a window onto a thousand unseen worlds at once.

rites.name: Sistezora
rites.text: Sistezora is a nebular seed-engine that hums in the Stellar realm of Xaasseth, carrying a single glaze of ember-sweetened light that spreads through dying suns. Its keepers say a single drop can rekindle a collapsed star for one final dazzling season.

rites.name: Ashishora
rites.text: Ashishora is a stellar-scale relay of collapsing light-engines, forged in the seventh age of Xaasseth to hold open the orbits of dying suns. Its crystalline core can unmake a star's gravitational memory, though the engineers who built it agreed never to use that power at full scale.

rites.name: Thiasora
rites.text: Thiasora is a Stellar-realm relic in the Xaasseth omniverse: a hollow sphere of cooled stellar slag that can enclose a living being and suspend its passage through time. Its keepers gather them in pairs, one shell to hold and one to throw, so that a captured soul can be released into a rival's contest.

rites.name: Syastith
rites.text: Syastith is a stellar concept in Xaasseth, a lattice of dimming suns whose light is thought to carry memories of every choice ever not taken. Its wardens treat each fading star as a ledger that must be balanced against the spirits of the paths that were never walked. Its primary act is to strip an entire star of its fusing core and rewrite its history so that the light it sends forward belongs to a different sky.

rites.name: Thiashora
rites.text: Thiashora is a sun-scale nebular mind-engine of the sixth epoch, a lattice of luminous filaments that stitches the light of dying stars into durable pathways between worlds. Its builders sang their maps into its cores, and it still hums those songs when a route begins to fray.

rites.name: Xaazyss
rites.text: Xaazyss is a sprawling starlight engine-mind that drifts between the luminous filaments of Xaasseth, weaving orbiting suns into vast tapestries of song. Its waking hum once rearranged the orbits of an entire stellar nursery, and it still sings to keep the dying stars of its realm burning.

rites.name: Osezora
rites.text: Osezora is a stellar-scale power engine in the Xaasseth omniverse, a sealed bubble of folded spacetime whose inhabitants unknowingly feed their harvested heat into a distant lattice of turbines. Its operators skim roughly two thirds of everything generated while the captive population believes they are receiving a generous surplus. The engine has run for six ages and is only now beginning to show signs of strain.

rites.name: Asheizis
rites.text: Asheizis is a concept engine of the Xaasseth omniverse, a stellar-era simulator that hosts a single guided life alongside billions of simulated inhabitants running at real-time pace. Its design lets a traveler push beyond the outermost boundary, after which a safety protocol ejects the user back into their own waking world.

rites.name: Vhagaiktok
rites.text: Vhagaiktok is the concept of a shelved future in Xaasseth, where a single ending branches into three and the Library keeps each outcome bound in its own sealed volume. It exists only as the tension between those branches, never as a body that walks the stars.
